source: GISSMO spin systems (gissmo.bmrb.io, simulation_N/spin_simulation.xml), merged coupling matrix (index 1)
reference: Dashti H, Westler WM, Tonelli M, Wedell JR, Markley JL, Eghbalnia HR. Spin System Modeling of Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectra for Applications in Metabolomics and Small Molecule Screening. Anal Chem 2017;89(22):12201-12208. doi:10.1021/acs.analchem.7b02884
selection: every compound of the reference (BMRB_Metabolomics_Mammalian) whose BMRB entry has a GISSMO system; simulation_1 unless fitted at 600 and another was not; less `excluded`
tube_order_note: the 58 compounds of the reference with a BMRB spectrum acquired at 600 MHz, in the order the tube draws their concentrations; those without a GISSMO system draw and are left out, so a tube is the same whichever are simulated

forms._about: GISSMO fits every form a compound takes in solution into one entry, each form at full weight. A form listed here is weighted by its share at equilibrium. D-glucose in D2O, 25-31 C: alpha-pyranose 36%, beta-pyranose 64% -- Angyal SJ, The composition of reducing sugars in solution, Adv Carbohydr Chem Biochem 1984;42:15-68.

excluded.L-tyrosine: GISSMO bmse000051 fitted the phenolate (basic pH): aromatic 6.59/6.99, alpha 3.42 ppm; the reference lists 6.89/7.18, 3.93 (median 0.20, max 0.51 ppm off)
excluded.Dopamine: GISSMO bmse000933 at 2.87/3.21/6.74-6.90 ppm; the reference lists 2.70/2.90/6.48-6.66 (median 0.11, max 0.26 ppm off)
